fact_text: An energy levy was imposed on all locally assembled cars in the FY26 budget, raising prices of models from 660cc to 2000cc by roughly Rs 2 to 7 lakh.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Broken Auto System Where Taxes Are Raised Only for the Poor | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: In the FY26 budget, customs duty on imported luxury vehicles was cut, lowering prices of models such as Land Cruiser, Prado, BMW and Bentley by up to about Rs 4 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Pakistan's Broken Auto System Where Taxes Are Raised Only for the Poor | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-07-22)

fact_text: The presenter argued the budget gave relief to buyers of expensive imported cars while middle-income buyers of basic locally assembled cars faced higher prices.
